messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: RStan standalone test with Rcpp
parts:
Before I go to Rcpp's help with this, I was wondering if anyone on this list knew how to create a standalone C++ program to that compiles and runs Rcpp code.

Here's a minimal example:
// test.cpp
#include <Rcpp.h>

int main(int argc, char const* argv[]) {
  Rcpp::NumericVector x(10);
  return 0;
}

I can compile it on my machine using this line:
clang++ test.cpp -isystem /Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Resources/include -I/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.0/Resources/library/Rcpp/include -L /Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Resources/include/../lib -l R

But when I run it, I get a seg fault:
> ./a.out
Segmentation fault: 11

I stumbled on it while trying to get some existing code under test so I can refactor it safely. I haven't been writing  So here's what I found online regarding this issue:
https://github.com/jjallaire/rcpp-gallery/issues/32
http://r.789695.n4.nabble.com/Rcpp-segmentation-faults-on-the-simplest-code-td3449290.html
(there are a few more links out there, but I'll save everyone the trouble)

So:
1) is this really non-sensical?
2) I'm guessing I can get it under test if I run it from R? Is there a fast way to run unit tests on bits of code? (without having to build the whole package, etc.)

messages.author: ab7b24da45678eac
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] RStan standalone test with Rcpp
parts:
This is an example I have:

$ make test.out
ccache g++  -DDEBUG -stdlib=libstdc++ -I/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Resources/include -I/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.0/Resources/library/RInside/include -I/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.0/Resources/library/Rcpp/include -I/Users/jq/Desktop/repo/rstan.repo/rstan/rstan/inst/include -I/Users/jq/Desktop/repo/stan.repo//src -I/Users/jq/Desktop/repo/stan.repo//lib/boost_1.54.0 -I/Users/jq/Desktop/repo/stan.repo//lib/eigen_3.2.0  -DBOOST_RESULT_OF_USE_TR1 -DBOOST_NO_DECLTYPE -DBOOST_DISABLE_ASSERTS -DBOOST_RESULT_OF_USE_TR1 -DBOOST_NO_DECLTYPE -DBOOST_DISABLE_ASSERTS -Wall -Waddress -g   -o test.out  test.cpp  /Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.0/Resources/library/RInside/lib/libRInside.a  -L/Users/jq/Desktop/repo/stan.repo//bin -L/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Resources/lib -lR -lstan

$ more test.cpp
#include <RInside.h>
int test(Rcpp::List& lst) {
  std::vector<int> v;
  for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++)
    v.push_back(i);
  lst = Rcpp::List(v.begin(), v.end());
  lst.attr("attr1") = 3;
  lst["v1"] = 4;
  return 0;
}
int main(int argc, char *argv[]) {
  RInside R(argc, argv);
  Rcpp::List lst;
  test(lst);
  R["txt"] = "Hello, world!\n";
  R["lst"] = lst;
  R.parseEvalQ("cat(txt)");
  R.parseEvalQ("print(lst)");
}
